snippet.title: Game Boy Advance - Superman Returns - Fortress of Solitude © 2006 EA Games - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Fortress of Solitude is a puzzle game set within Superman's arctic retreat that features occasional "interruptions" by villains which turn into flying action stages where Superman must use his heat vision and ice breath to destroy enemies to collect items. Each of the puzzles is timed in addition to having a cumulative timer for all the puzzles in the level.
